start: Owner signed in online, More > Staff & sign-in, only the owner on the list

steps.action: Tap 'Add a person', type a name and a 10-digit mobile number, leave 'What is their job?' on 'Staff (front desk)', save
user_sees: Sheet 'Add a person' with 'Mobile number' (+91) and 'What is their job?'
Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
The new row with a 'Staff' pill and 'Not signed in yet'
must_not: The person gets owner powers
Two rows for one save
A sign-in code or message sent to the person by itself

steps.action: On the new row tap 'Make sign-in code'
user_sees: Button reads 'Making…'
Sheet 'Sign-in code for <name>' with a 6-digit code
'Works once, till <time> (<n> minutes).'
Buttons 'Copy the code' and 'Send on WhatsApp'
must_not: A code shown for another person
The code still works after one use
A WhatsApp sent without the owner tapping send in WhatsApp

steps.action: Close the sheet and look at the row
user_sees: '· Code works till <time>' on the row
must_not: The code itself printed on the list
An older code for the same person still working

start: Owner on Add a person, wants to add a trainer and a manager

user_sees: Hint under the job box changes for Trainer
Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
Row pill 'Trainer' and the Trainer tick on
must_not: The trainer is given owner access
Toast says added-as-trainer when the trainer tick failed (it must say '<name> added with front desk access, but not marked as a trainer yet. Tick Trainer on their row.')

steps.action: Add a person with job 'Other', leave the job box empty, save; then type 'Manager' and save
user_sees: First: an error under the job box and nothing saved
Then: the row shows a 'Manager' pill
must_not: A person saved with an empty job
The typed job lost after a refresh on this browser
'Other' gives more than front desk access

start: Owner opens Staff & sign-in for the own row (new phone)

steps.action: On the row marked 'You' tap 'Make sign-in code'
user_sees: Sheet 'Your sign-in code'
'On the phone or computer where you want to sign in, open app.mettleup.fit, tap Sign in, and type +91 <number> and this code.'
must_not: A 'Remove' button on the owner's own row
This device signed out by making the code

start: Owner on the 'Add a person' sheet

steps.action: Tap save with the name empty
user_sees: 'Type their name.'
must_not: A person saved without a name

steps.action: Type a name and a 9-digit number, save
user_sees: 'Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345.'
must_not: A short number saved
The sheet closes

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a person already on the list, save
user_sees: A plain error on the sheet; the sheet stays open with what was typed
must_not: A second row for the same number
A raw server code shown
The first person's sign-in or PIN changed

start: A browser-only gym (not online), owner opens Staff & sign-in

user_sees: Title 'Staff & sign-in', 'Who can open this gym, on which phone'
'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data). Then you and your staff can sign in with a mobile number, on any phone or computer.'
Button 'Go to Settings'
must_not: An 'Add a person' button that fails
An empty list with no reason

start: Owner, a front desk person signed in on 2 devices with a PIN set

steps.action: On their row tap 'Sign out everywhere'
user_sees: Sheet 'Sign <name> out everywhere?'
'<name> is signed out of every phone and computer. They can sign in again with a new code. Their PIN stops working too. To get back in, they need a new code; then they set a new PIN.'
must_not: Signed out before the owner confirms

user_sees: Toast 'Signed out.'
Row says 'Signed out'; the 'Sign out everywhere' button is gone
must_not: The person can still save anything on the old devices
The old PIN still signs in
The person removed from the list

steps.action: Tap 'Make sign-in code' again, then tap red 'Remove', confirm 'Remove'
user_sees: Sheet 'Remove <name>?' with 'They can’t sign in again. Your members and payments stay as they are.'
Toast '<name> removed.'
The row is gone
must_not: The code made a moment ago still signs the removed person in
Payments or members the person saved are changed
The owner can remove the own row

start: Owner on Staff & sign-in; a front desk person opens the same page on another phone

user_sees: Each person: name, job pill, '+91 <mobile>', 'Signed in on N devices' or 'Signed out', whether a PIN is set
must_not: A PIN or a sign-in code value shown in the list
People of another gym or another branch's staff listed

steps.action: The front desk person opens Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Card 'You' and 'Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner.'
The staff rights line
must_not: Other people's mobile numbers shown to staff
'Add a person', 'Make sign-in code' or 'Remove' shown to staff
